name: orchestkit
description: The Complete AI Development Toolkit - 110 skills, 36 agents, 38 commands, 169 hooks for full-stack development

metadata.description: AI-assisted development plugin with built-in best practices, security patterns, quality gates, and multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code.

plugins.name: ork
plugins.description: Complete AI development toolkit with 105 skills covering AI/LLM, backend, frontend, security, and testing patterns. Includes 36 specialized agents, 35 commands, and 218 lifecycle hooks.

plugins.name: ork-alpha
plugins.description: Prerelease channel for OrchestKit. Tracks main, so it carries alpha and beta builds ahead of the stable ork plugin. Install only if you want unreleased changes.

plugins.name: lesson-cards
plugins.description: Mod (function hooks): lesson hint cards when a tool call matches a known pattern; /lessons reloads. Requires Claude Code 2.1.266+. On 2.1.266 to 2.1.286 set CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1; on 2.1.287+ Mods are public.

plugins.name: promote-lights
plugins.description: Mod (function hooks): CI lights above the prompt while a promote PR is open, or for any PR with /lights watch owner/repo#N; /lights [off|refresh|watch]. Requires Claude Code 2.1.266+. On 2.1.266 to 2.1.286 set CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1; on 2.1.287+ Mods are public.

plugins.name: secrets-veil
plugins.description: Mod (function hooks): masks secret values in tool results before the model reads them. Requires Claude Code 2.1.266+. On 2.1.266 to 2.1.286 set CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1; on 2.1.287+ Mods are public.

plugins.name: memory-lens
plugins.description: Mod (function hooks): recalls the few memories related to each prompt; /memory-lens for stats, reload and show. Requires Claude Code 2.1.266+. On 2.1.266 to 2.1.286 set CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1; on 2.1.287+ Mods are public.
